package.description: A language and environment for creative coding

en-US.description: A language and environment for creative coding
en-US.longDescription: Processing is a flexible software sketchbook and a language for learning how to code within the context of the visual arts. Since 2001, Processing has promoted software literacy within the visual arts and visual literacy within technology.
en-US.name: Processing

zh-CN.description: 面向视觉艺术的编程语言与创作环境
zh-CN.longDescription: Processing 是一个灵活的软件速写本和一门编程语言，用于在视觉艺术的语境中学习如何编写代码。自 2001 年以来，Processing 一直在视觉艺术领域推广软件素养，并在技术领域推广视觉素养。

package.longDescription: Processing is a flexible software sketchbook and a language for learning how to code within the context of the visual arts. Since 2001, Processing has promoted software literacy within the visual arts and visual literacy within technology.
package.name: Processing
